svg.title: Operate Six Core Seats; Add Two Only in the Scaled Model
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-six-core-eight-scaled-publishing-seats; chart type: org_architecture; title: Operate Six Core Seats; Add Two Only in the Scaled Model; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 2 FT + 4 C. Scaled: 3 FT + 5 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Eight depicted seats represent the Scaled organization; six are core and two are explicitly Scaled-only. Each numeric value represents one person, not a full-time equivalent. Contractor seats are fractional service relationships. Revenue scenarios do not establish workload capacity by themselves.; caption: Core seats support the canonical $80,000 Conservative and $490,000 Base scenarios; the eight-person configuration belongs to the $900,000 Scaled scenario. Do not apply Base labor budgets to Conservative revenue without resizing paid capacity.; stages: label: Portfolio operator; value: Core seat 1: full-time portfolio ownership; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own topic allocation, site-level profit reporting, partner concentration, and capital deployment. Maintain the rights register and transaction-ready operating records for potential exits.; label: Managing editor; value: Core seat 2: full-time editorial ownership; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own evidence standards, contributor briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh priorities. Review risky commercial claims and prevent duplicative programmatic page expansion.; label: Technical SEO engineer; value: Core seat 3: contracted technical delivery; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain crawl monitoring, template tests, structured data, and deployment checks. Route indexing regressions to a tracked repair queue instead of mass resubmission.; label: Subject specialist; value: Core seat 4: contracted research and writing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Produce original explanations, product testing records, and attributable expert contributions. Deliver source packets and explicit rights documentation with every assignment.; label: Production specialist; value: Core seat 5: contracted visual and CMS production; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Create licensed or original visuals, format accessible pages, and maintain CMS consistency. Verify internal links and disclosure placement before scheduled publication.; label: Revenue analyst; value: Core seat 6: contracted measurement and reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile advertising statements, payable affiliate events, and sponsorship delivery. Publish revenue per session, receivable aging, and partner exposure without merchant-sales inflation.; label: Growth partnerships lead; value: Scaled-only seat 7: additional full-time commercial owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add in the Scaled configuration to diversify sponsorships and manage partner renewals. Protect editorial independence and document placement obligations before recognizing sponsor revenue.; label: Second subject specialist; value: Scaled-only seat 8: additional contracted production capacity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add in the Scaled configuration for a second validated topic cluster. Expand production only after measuring editorial review capacity and existing refresh backlog.

text.title: operating_framework

circle.title: label: Portfolio operator; value: Core seat 1: full-time portfolio ownership; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own topic allocation, site-level profit reporting, partner concentration, and capital deployment. Maintain the rights register and transaction-ready operating records for potential exits.

text.title: Portfolio operator
Own topic allocation, site-level profit reporting, partner concentration, and capital deployment. Maintain the rights register and transaction-ready operating records for potential exits.

circle.title: label: Managing editor; value: Core seat 2: full-time editorial ownership; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own evidence standards, contributor briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh priorities. Review risky commercial claims and prevent duplicative programmatic page expansion.

text.title: Managing editor
Own evidence standards, contributor briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh priorities. Review risky commercial claims and prevent duplicative programmatic page expansion.

circle.title: label: Technical SEO engineer; value: Core seat 3: contracted technical delivery; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain crawl monitoring, template tests, structured data, and deployment checks. Route indexing regressions to a tracked repair queue instead of mass resubmission.

text.title: Technical SEO engineer
Maintain crawl monitoring, template tests, structured data, and deployment checks. Route indexing regressions to a tracked repair queue instead of mass resubmission.

circle.title: label: Subject specialist; value: Core seat 4: contracted research and writing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Produce original explanations, product testing records, and attributable expert contributions. Deliver source packets and explicit rights documentation with every assignment.

text.title: Subject specialist
Produce original explanations, product testing records, and attributable expert contributions. Deliver source packets and explicit rights documentation with every assignment.

circle.title: label: Production specialist; value: Core seat 5: contracted visual and CMS production; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Create licensed or original visuals, format accessible pages, and maintain CMS consistency. Verify internal links and disclosure placement before scheduled publication.

text.title: Production specialist
Create licensed or original visuals, format accessible pages, and maintain CMS consistency. Verify internal links and disclosure placement before scheduled publication.

circle.title: label: Revenue analyst; value: Core seat 6: contracted measurement and reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile advertising statements, payable affiliate events, and sponsorship delivery. Publish revenue per session, receivable aging, and partner exposure without merchant-sales inflation.

text.title: Revenue analyst
Reconcile advertising statements, payable affiliate events, and sponsorship delivery. Publish revenue per session, receivable aging, and partner exposure without merchant-sales inflation.

circle.title: label: Growth partnerships lead; value: Scaled-only seat 7: additional full-time commercial owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add in the Scaled configuration to diversify sponsorships and manage partner renewals. Protect editorial independence and document placement obligations before recognizing sponsor revenue.

text.title: Growth partnerships lead
Add in the Scaled configuration to diversify sponsorships and manage partner renewals. Protect editorial independence and document placement obligations before recognizing sponsor revenue.
